verdict.rationale: monday.com has extensive agent-oriented developer documentation (MCP server, agents API, webhook subscriptions, scopes, programmatic control) that an AI agent could be pointed at, satisfying the 'agent-oriented docs' half of the story. However, a direct probe confirms llms.txt returns HTTP 404, so the specific llms.txt convention is not supported. Missing for 10: a working llms.txt file, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent can actually consume the developer docs autonomously.
